faq.q: What photo can I post from the lip balm picture I have?
faq.a: It builds a product photo from the picture you already have, so you can put a scene on the product page. The lip balm stays the item you uploaded.

faq.q: How do I turn a lip balm photo into a scene I can post?
faq.a: Use the clearest picture you have of the lip balm, plus a sentence about where it should sit. A full tube reads better than a dark crop. You can add up to 7 reference photos. Ask for warmer light if the first file looks cold. Name the vanity, and keep the cap in the frame.

faq.q: What should I check before I post the lip balm photo?
faq.a: Check that the lip balm still matches what you sell. The file should keep the shape and the color buyers recognize.

faq.q: Can I make a lip balm photo before I pick a plan?
faq.a: No. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Each photo is 24 credits. Pro is $35 for 300 credits, and Premium is $63 for 600. You see the number before the photo is made.

faq.q: Can I put the lip balm photo on the product page?
faq.a: Yes. A lip balm can use one file on the product page and another in an email. Check the tube color against the one you pack before either file goes out.

faq.q: What do I get if I already have a supplier photo of the balm?
faq.a: It adds a scene to the supplier shot, such as the balm on a vanity, while keeping the product recognizable.

faq.q: Can I post the lip balm photo on my store and in ads?
faq.a: Yes. The file downloads with no watermark. You still have to own the photo you started from, or have permission to use it. Our [AI product photography guide](page:blog-ai-product-photography-guide) covers that check.

faq.q: Can I add my price or logo before I post the photo?
faq.a: Add prices, offers, and logo text in your own editor after download. Words drawn onto the photo can come out wrong, so proof them. See [Shopify product photos](page:plat-shopify) for where those files usually go.

faq.q: Where do I find a template for the lip balm photo?
faq.a: Browse [product ad templates](page:templates) for plain product photos, lifestyle scenes, and ad layouts. Then upload your photo here and describe the scene.

faq.q: Can I make a stack of photos, or connect the store I already run?
faq.a: Yes. Upload several photos, or send them from store software through the API, then make a scene for each one.

faq.q: Can the lip balm photo become a video with a spoken line?
faq.a: Yes. Turn that photo into a product video, then add a spoken voice, on-screen captions, or a song from the music library. A 6-second clip uses 24 credits. A 10-second clip uses 40, a 15-second clip uses 60, and a 30-second clip uses 120. [Image to video](page:image-to-video) is that next step.
